shortIntro.title: Can Your Phone Handle CSR Racing 2 Without Breaking a Sweat? 🏎️🔥
shortIntro.para1: CSR Racing 2 is all about lightning-fast reactions, perfect gear shifts, and drag races that feel straight out of a Hollywood action scene. There’s no steering here — just raw timing and flawless performance.
shortIntro.para2: With ultra-detailed cars, reflective paint jobs, and cinematic race effects, CSR2 demands serious graphical power. If your phone lags, you won’t just lose races — you’ll lose bragging rights 😅.

intro: Here’s a complete breakdown of the minimum and ideal device specifications needed to enjoy CSR Racing 2 smoothly on Android and iOS — whether you’re a casual racer or a garage-collecting perfectionist 🏆.

minimum.RAM: 3GB (runs fine, but loading may feel slow ⏳)
minimum.Internet: Always-on connection required for events & PvP 🛜

recommended.RAM: 6GB+ for faster loads and smoother visuals 🚀
recommended.Storage: 6GB+ free for car packs and live events
recommended.Internet: Stable Wi-Fi or 5G for real-time races 🏁

ios_intro: On iOS devices, CSR Racing 2 shines 🍏. Apple’s hardware optimization delivers fluid animations, rich lighting, and consistently smooth drag races even during intense online events.
fps_intro: In CSR Racing 2, FPS isn’t about aiming — it’s about visual clarity and precise shift timing 😎.
settings_intro: Fine-tuning your settings can improve race smoothness without sacrificing your phone’s health 🛠️.

low_end.title: Visual Effects
low_end.value: Turn off heavy reflections and blur

low_end.title: Background Apps
low_end.value: Close unused apps to speed up loading

high_end.title: Graphics Quality
high_end.value: High or Ultra for showroom-level visuals ✨

high_end.title: Frame Rate
high_end.value: Enable Max FPS for accurate gear shifts

high_end.title: Free Storage
high_end.value: Keep extra space for faster garage access

faqIntroText: CSR Racing 2 FAQs — quick answers before the next race 😎:

faqList.question: Is CSR Racing 2 demanding on hardware?
faqList.answer: Yes. The game uses high-quality car models and lighting effects, which require a capable GPU and enough RAM.

faqList.question: Does CSR Racing 2 support 60 FPS?
faqList.answer: Yes, on mid-range and flagship devices. Budget phones usually stay around 30 FPS.

faqList.question: Why does CSR2 consume so much storage?
faqList.answer: Each vehicle and event adds detailed textures and animations. High realism comes with a storage cost 😅.
